title: Impact of School District Boundaries on Urban House Prices
research_question: How do school district boundaries affect house prices in urban areas? Specifically, does proximity to a less desirable school district negatively impact property values?
data_description: The dataset includes 500 observations of houses located near the boundary of two urban school districts. Key columns are running_var (distance to the boundary), treated (indicator for being in the less desirable district), and y (log house prices).

ground_truth.identification_strategy: The identification strategy leverages the discontinuity at the school district boundary.
ground_truth.conclusion_detail: Houses in the less desirable school district exhibit lower log prices.

_fix_notes.description: Ground-truth effect and direction corrected to match actual data. Root cause: extend_exp_b_to_100.py:267 applied abs() before passing effect to make_rdd(), so the synthetic CSV has positive effect while the JSON recorded the original signed value. Data file unchanged; only JSON metadata updated.
